verdicts.reason: A breaks the composition: 'DENTAL SERVICES' is set on one line, jammed into the tooth and girl at right, and the background teeth are squeezed into a cramped row of tiny shapes under the headline, with empty blue fields on both sides. B keeps the original's arrangement (headline on the big tooth, girl beside it, teeth scattered behind) and the brand feel. But it is basically a shrunk copy: the two-line headline is small at 50px tall, and the edge teeth are cropped. It needs polish, but it is coherent.
